title: NVQ course matrix restored
details: The NVQ course arch now opens the qualification by official unit instead of the A-E evidence-collection categories
Each unit shows AC coverage and retains Milos assessor-observed coverage returned by QR
Opening a unit shows its official ACs with Evia evidence, RPL and Milos-observed status
The A-E practical evidence structure remains available for evidence collection and has not been removed
No Milos recording, QR transfer or learner evidence data is changed
summary: Evia v240 restores the learner-facing NVQ course matrix to the official qualification units while keeping Milos-observed blue coverage intact.
